concept_decisions: Concept has correct lowered bowl and raised rim; remove photograph-like grain and orderly horizontal cut-base stripes, no central raised object. Build continuous volume irregular near-round terrain apron with plain level around260m, broken rim around380-420m, bowl floor around35m above lower cut. Bowl remains below surrounding plain, not cone with summit pit. Small irregular radial erosional cuts integrated into inward walls; natural asymmetry avoiding donut torus and perfectly repeated sectors. Ejecta apron merges gradually into plain, no separate clasts crossing coplanar surfaces.
